title: Hollywood Unlocked' Jason Lee Rips TMZ & Harvey Levin And Says Lawsuit On The Way
htmlContent:
According to MSN.com, earlier this year, numerous celebrities, Kanye West, Julia Fox, Madonna, Floyd Mayweather, Evan Ross, Jason Lee, and Antonio Brown, gathered at Delilah in West Hollywood, California.

"They all had dinner in the private dining room. They came separately, but just ended up having dinner together," a source tells People. "Kanye and Julia wouldn't leave each other's sides," the insider said, referring to Fox's leg draping over West.

Hollywood Unlocked's Jason Lee also shared footage of celebrities listening to Drake's "Come Thru" from his 2013 album "Nothing Was The Same."

Speaking of Jason Lee, he made a recent appearance on Drink Champ. During his conversation with NORE & DJ EFN, they talked about that iconic photo, video, how TMZ apparently stole the footage and didn't appropriately credit it. Per Lee, they will be taking legal action against the media platform.

"We have not filed it yet, but yeah, we will send them a letter to start the process. Yeah, it is not surprising that white people steal from black people; white people steal from black culture. I mean, Harvey [Levin] has been a c***s***** for a long time. I don't know if it's because he's old or he's on his way out. I heard that he sold TMZ, but that's what they do, right? They buy and trade like they did to slaves too, but I ain't no slave n***. And this is what I told TMZ, Right? You can use my content like I use your content, but there's proper crediting," said Lee.

There's just a culture that exists within media, licensing, and yeah, they posted it, but it's just a proper way to handle business. We have a policy at Hollywood Unlocked on how my writers use their content. You can't just take my content, but not only that, though, I knew how iconic it was. So let me tell you how I got these b**** together and set them up for a lawsuit."

"Once I saw what was happening, Ye [Kanye West] said, let's take a photo because you had everyone on there from Madonna, Ye, AB, Floyd Mayweather to even my a** which was the less notable, but still in the picture have all been canceled at some point. AB cancel for taking off his shirt, Floyd they said he was [allegedly] a woman beater, me for throwing a drink on Love & Hip Hop, Ye every other day, and even Madonna for the stuff she was doing back in the 80s. When I looked at the moment and said this is iconic. So, what I did was before I posted it, we filed for Copywrite to protect it."

Speaking of Madonna, It was recently announced that there will be a Bio-Pic on her, and she would be directing it along with co-writing the script with Diablo Cody.

"I want to convey the incredible journey that life has taken me on as an artist, a musician, a dancer - a human being, trying to make her way in this world. The focus of this film will always be music. Music has kept me going and art has kept me alive. There are so many untold and inspiring stories and who better to tell it than me. It's essential to share the roller coaster ride of my life with my voice and vision."

It was also announced that they are looking for an actress to possibly play the iconic singer.

Per The Hollywood Reporter, Julia Garner and Florence Pugh are still in the running to land the role.

"The reason I'm doing it is because a bunch of people have tried to write movies about me, but they're always men," Madonna said in October during an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon.

As for Jason Lee, he's joining Ye’s team as his Head of Media and Partnerships, according to Variety.

 “Ye voiced a vision for a company he was building, and that media was an arm of that, and he felt I could be an asset," said Lee.
